_comment: GENERATED by Phase 155-05. Blueprint families drive persona-conditional scaffolding. All section slugs MUST appear in the SECTION_NAMES frozen table in lib/core/room-skeleton-scaffold.cjs. run: node scripts/check-room-blueprints.cjs --check

exploration.description: Blank-slate or CV-passer persona: map a domain or interest before committing to a problem statement.
exploration._sections_note: domain-decomposition is not a frozen slug; substituted problem-definition (houses domain analysis + diagnosis). opportunity-bank substituted for the domain-decomposition sub-sections per BIRTH-FLOW-BRIEF.md Section 3.

solution-first.description: Solution-seeking-problem: the navigator arrives with a working solution and needs to find the right problem and user.
solution-first._sections_note: analogies/ is not a frozen slug; substituted competitive-analysis (competitive landscape analysis includes analogy mapping). BIRTH-FLOW-BRIEF.md Section 3: solution-design seeded first.

problem-first.description: Problem-seeking-business: the navigator has observed a real problem and needs to find the business model and solution.
problem-first._sections_note: mullins/ and validation sub-section are not frozen slugs; opportunity-bank substitutes for the mullins pipeline staging area per BIRTH-FLOW-BRIEF.md Section 3.

business-first.description: Business-case-seeking-problem: the navigator has a revenue logic or business case and needs to validate the underlying problem.
business-first._sections_note: BIRTH-FLOW-BRIEF.md Section 3: business-model seeded first. All 4 slugs are in the frozen SECTION_NAMES table.

portfolio.description: Portfolio steward persona class: TTO / VC / PE / venture studio / accelerator / CVC / family office. The steward room is a room factory; unit-of-account varies by sub-type.
portfolio._arrival_assets_note: Decision 7 (BIRTH-FLOW-BRIEF.md): portfolio steward is a persona CLASS not TTO alone. Part 8 P1 LPA confidentiality covers the full class.
portfolio._sections_note: portfolio/, assets/, connections/ are not frozen slugs. Substituted: opportunity-bank (the primary steward work surface), market-analysis, competitive-analysis, problem-definition. financial-model and legal-ip are intentionally omitted day-1 per BIRTH-FLOW-BRIEF.md Section 3.

venture.description: Sole entrepreneur or defined venture: the navigator arrives with a venture in hand. Reproduces the SECTION_NAMES frozen 8 for backwards compatibility.
venture._sections_note: Exact reproduction of the SECTION_NAMES frozen table in room-skeleton-scaffold.cjs. Backwards-compat guarantee: callers that pass blueprintFamily='venture' get the same sections as callers that pass no blueprintFamily.

program.description: Program or initiative: the navigator is launching a program, grant initiative, or institutional project rather than a commercial venture.
program._sections_note: BIRTH-FLOW-BRIEF.md Section 3: program persona shares exploration + team execution focus without financial-model / legal-ip day 1.

case-study.description: Case-study persona: the navigator is analyzing an existing venture or situation to extract lessons and apply them.
case-study._sections_note: BIRTH-FLOW-BRIEF.md Section 3: case-study pattern = problem + solution + market + financial outcomes. All 4 slugs are in the frozen SECTION_NAMES table.
